### Profile: `pizza_order_test_custom`
This profile includes the following relevant outputs:
- `price`: The final price of the pizza order.
- `size`: The size of the pizza.
- `toppings`: The toppings selected for the pizza.

### Rule: `more_toppings_cost_more`
This rule checks if adding more toppings to a custom pizza costs more:
```yaml
active: true
conversations: 2
description: Adding more toppings to a custom pizza cost more
if: 'len(conv[0].toppings) > len(conv[1].toppings)'
name: more_toppings_cost_more
then: 'extract_float(conv[0].price) > extract_float(conv[1].price)'
when: 'conv[0].size == conv[1].size and conv[0].drink == conv[1].drink'

name: same_number_of_toppings_cost_the_same
then: 'extract_float(conv[0].price) == extract_float(conv[1].price)'
when: 'conv[0].drink == conv[1].drink'
```
- This rule also relies on the `price`, `size`, and `toppings` outputs.
